purpose: Release qualification receipt for DeepSeek-V4-Flash inactive-route correctness, native KV tier replay, and GLM-5.2 B12X runtime contracts

b12x.post_build_audit: The same tree is produced by b12x master c25cdba2c1df7a69b2d7771e4243e12a8fbf19d5 plus the unmerged heads represented by pull requests 145, 221, 223, and 227.

implemented_contracts.deepseek_inactive_routes: Tiny-decode and native W4A16 B12X kernels treat negative and out-of-range expert identifiers as inactive routes without dereferencing expert tables.
implemented_contracts.deepseek_dspark_graphs: Target decode, DSpark draft decode, and DFlash context-KV execution capture FULL CUDA graphs for the qualified row envelope.
implemented_contracts.deepseek_direct_dsml: The DeepSeek V4 tool parser accepts the checkpoint's legacy direct DSML tool-call form in addition to the channel-prefixed form.
implemented_contracts.native_kv_tiering: Filesystem-tier objects are published from writer-owned inodes and remain replayable across engine restart.
implemented_contracts.glm_projection_mixed_experts: Projection-mixed MCG K3/K4/K5 routed experts are loaded without forcing a single layer-wide bitrate.
implemented_contracts.glm_sparse_mla: The B12X GLM sparse MLA path validates cache dtype, nested dense-decode metadata, sparse-request coverage, and shared capture/runtime workspace state.

source_validation.docker_compose_contracts: pass: DeepSeek-V4-Flash and GLM-5.2 EXL3/NVFP4 profiles
source_validation.b12x_combined_source_tests: pass: 21 tests with Ruff check and format
source_validation.b12x_gpu_graph_and_route_tests: pass: mapped route planning, inactive-route masking, eager execution, and CUDA graph replay
source_validation.source_composition: pass: immutable integration locks and no private source patches

result: DeepSeek-V4-Flash TP2/DCP1 DSpark K5 completed the exact MAX_NUM_SEQS=8 and graph-row-48 report envelope without inactive-route corruption. A 160-request strict-tool soak, concurrent 32k/64k request-isolation gate, C1 engine-rate control, full CUDA graphs, and native filesystem-tier restart replay passed. GLM-5.2 projection-mixed loader and sparse-MLA contracts passed focused tests in the release image.
limitations: The remote validation host has four available 96 GB GPUs. It cannot load the GLM-5.2 TP8 NVFP4 profile, and no full-checkpoint GLM E2E result is claimed for this exact image.
GLM-5.2 full-checkpoint qualification requires community TP4 EXL3 and TP8 NVFP4 execution on the published image.
DeepSeek runtime qualification covers TP2/DCP1 fixed probabilistic DSpark K5. Other topologies remain supported profiles but are not part of this receipt.
SQG checkpoint support is intentionally absent from the release composition.
